title: Hold an authority to take, keep or deal in protected animals
what: Take, keep, buy or sell protected animals only under an animal authority, such as a dealer licence under the Nature Conservation (Animals) Regulation 2020.

sources.title: Nature Conservation Act 1992 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person must not take a protected animal unless the person is an authorised person or the taking is authorised under this Act

sources.title: Nature Conservation Act 1992 (Qld)
sources.quote: a person, other than an authorised person, must not keep or use a protected animal that is either of the following unless the keeping or use is authorised under this Act or the Exhibited Animals Act 2015

sources.title: Nature Conservation (Animals) Regulation 2020 (Qld)
sources.quote: The holder of a dealer licence, or a relevant person for the holder, may carry out any of the following activities— (a) buy, accept, or receive an authorised animal for processing the animal

administration.who: Chief executive of the department administering the Nature Conservation Act 1992 (Qld)

sources.title: Nature Conservation (Animals) Regulation 2020 (Qld)
sources.locator: s 138(1), words naming the body (found 23 Nov 2026) (current)
sources.quote: The chief executive must not grant a dealer licence to a child.
